newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LATE GOAL KEEPS HEARTS IN SCOTTISH CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE GOAL KEEPS HEARTS IN SCOTTISH CUP.

text.p: A goal from Jim Hamilton nine minutes from time gave last season's beaten finalists Hearts a 1-1 draw with Dundee United in the fourth round of the Scottish F.A. Cup on Sunday.
Hamilton appeared to be offside when he scored, but the referee allowed the goal to stand and it cancelled out a 67th minute own goal from Alan McManus.
The teams will replay at Tannadice on February 25 and the winners will play either Motherwell or Hamilton in the quarterfinals.
